planets.name: TIC 139270665 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TIC 139270665 with a 23.6-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TIC 139270665 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TIC 139270665. Its orbit and size follow Peluso et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
